description: This file contains implementation of a generic BlobExampleStorage class, a factory for creating instances, and extension methods for configuring storage in an Orleans silo builder. It defines storage behavior, factory creation, and registration extensions.

classes.name: BlobExampleStorage
classes.description: A generic storage implementation that holds a state of type TState, with methods to save and retrieve extended info.

classes.name: BlobExampleStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of BlobExampleStorage, utilizing Orleans grain context accessor.

classes.name: BlobExampleStorageExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension method to configure BlobExampleStorage in an Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Completes immediately, representing a save operation.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns a string with the storage name and state type.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new storage instance for a given state type.

methods.name: UseBlobExampleStorage
methods.description: Extension method to register BlobExampleStorage and its factory in the silo builder.
